svg.title: Primary layer · one centre of gravity
svg.desc: Proposed layout with a single origin bank, six inner spires on Realm ring two, a complete mountain barrier on primary rings 33 through 35, and the existing spire lattice extended through Realm ring thirty. Realm settlements begin at Realm ring three.
svg.text: Primary layer · one centre of gravity
Realm rings 0–30 · 450 primary hexes to the outer spire ring · one bank at (0, 0)
Grid steps are Realm positions, not individual primary hexes. Spires replace Realm sites. Ring labels: Realm / primary.
Spire lattice retained at Realm rings 6, 12, 18, 24 and extended to 30; six additional inner spires sit on Realm ring 2.
